thread_text:
frank: Quick itemthe /guides/retries page still shows the old status URL and lacks the short workaround we gave customers during the outage. Need a tiny docs hotfix. Can someone pick up?

tayla: Happy to. Will open a small PR that: 1) adds a one-line Known Issue callout, 2) replaces the broken status link with the incident permalink, 3) adds a minimal curl snippet for 3 retries with exponential backoff. Will request sam + anita for review.

sam: Sounds good. Keep banner short and avoid implying SDK auto-retries. Suggest banner: "Known issue (2026-03-19 23:09-23:18 UTC): intermittent 503s. Workaround: retry with exponential backoff (up to 3 attempts). See [status link]."

docs-ci: Preview: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr-4701 link check flagged one image path; content diff small.

tayla: Fixed image path and pushed commit. Snippet added: ```bash
for i in 0 1 2; do
  curl -f -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":32}' && break || sleep $((2**i))
done
```

anita: Approving. Please insert exact permalink: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/2026-03-19/kennel-02 and note we'll link the postmortem later.

merge-bot: No infra changes detected; eligible for fast-track merge.

tayla: Merged per matt's window. Will backport only if customers on release-v1.2 raise issues. Thanks for the quick reviews!
